summary: Round 5 of the D12 Stage-9 figure review, judged on the typeset PDF. The artefact freeze held and was verified two ways - the PDF postdates every PNG by 2.30 s and embeds all three pixel-identically (maxdiff 0) - so round-4's D12-R4-XF-01 FAIL is closed. All eight figure-visible round-4 items landed. The typeset-legibility contract is now met by measurement, not just by the helper's own arithmetic: enumerating every text-bearing field, including the two classes the helper still does not read, gives a global minimum of 8.83 pt (fig 1) and 8.69 pt (figs 2-3), and independent cap-height measurement against the 9 pt REVTeX caption on the same rendered page returns 8.82 pt for fig 1 and 8.65 pt for fig 3's witness labels - the round-4 6.38 pt breach is genuinely gone. Physics was re-derived from formulas.py rather than inherited: panel (B)'s shading contains zero samples below the analytic crossover 51.395903, the (50,60) witness reproduces at 9.5445 with ratio 3492 on both panels that carry it, ENBW*T is exactly 1/2 for the boxcar at every sampled T with the ramp exactly 2/3 above it, and |1-L| is 2 at L = 3 with 4 at both L = 5 and L = -3 on opposite sides of the drawn stability boundary. Not ALL PASS, but nothing blocking: one MAJOR tooling finding (scripts/review_figures.py aborts with NameError, so the deterministic half of Stage 9 has never run for D11 or D12 and its cached outputs predate both bundles) and three MINORs - fig 2's x-axis title and legend row 1 set with 0.12 pt of clearance, a mis-keyed FIGURE_REGISTRY ordinate expectation for fig 3 that is the unlanded residue of D12-R4-F3-04, and a band label rotating against the ordinate titles in its own figure.
